    ARI Robot Demonstrators

    Published in PAL Robotics, 2020

    Overview

    During my time as ARI Robot Technical Expert, I supported the product management of ARI, a high-performance social robot designed for healthcare and assistive applications. I was also the technical contact of several of its healthcare projects, both national (AMIBA) and EU (SPRING, SHAPES).

    This role involved coordinating between business, marketing, managers, and the technical team to define, maintain, and prioritize features of the robot, ensuring it met both user and project requirements.

    This section showcases selected technical demonstrators I contributed to, highlighting ARI’s capabilities in healthcare and assistive scenarios. It also reflects my participation in events and conferences, demonstrating ARI to prospective clients and collaborators.

    ARI WebGUI

    Demonstration of the ARI Robot WebGUI, the web-based interface developed to remotely operate and monitor ARI.

    Key features include:

    • Remote control of navigation and manipulation
    • Real-time sensor data and robot status monitoring
    • Integration with healthcare and assistive applications

    My Contribution: I contributed to the design and integration of the WebGUI, ensuring the interface supported safe and effective remote operation, and coordinating requirements with the product team.

    Video demonstration:

    SHAPES Project Video

    Official project video produced by PAL Robotics for the H2020 SHAPES project, showcasing the social robotic application developed with ARI to support active and healthy ageing. The video highlights:

    • Multimodal interaction and expressive behaviors
    • Integration of ARI with digital healthcare solutions
    • Evaluation in real-world pilot scenarios

    My Contribution: I contributed to the technical development and integration of ARI’s social behaviors in the SHAPES project, ensuring the robot could perform expressive and interactive actions in a healthcare context.

    ARI at Conferences and Events

    I also had the opportunity to represent ARI at various conferences and events, engaging with researchers, industry professionals, and potential collaborators. My responsibilities included:

    • Demonstrating ARI’s capabilities in healthcare and assistive robotics through EU projects I worked on: H2020 SHAPES, H2020 SPRING.
    • Explaining technical features and applications to diverse audiences
    • Supporting networking and collaboration opportunities

    Notable events include:

    ICSR 2022 — Florence, Italy

    RO-MAN 2022 — Naples, Italy

    These experiences allowed me to combine technical expertise with outreach, showcasing ARI’s real-world impact and fostering potential collaborations.
